info.description: HTTP API for the SweetRPG Game Room domain: a user's library (owned catalog volumes), wishlists, play tables, and peer-to-peer volume loans, each with per-resource visibility controls.
info.title: Game Room API service

get.description: Check the application's own health plus its dependencies (database, cache). Returns 503 if any dependency check fails.

503.description: one or more dependency checks failed

get.description: Get a user's library, filtered to what the caller may see.

put.description: Set the visibility applied to library entries that have no per-entry override. Valid visibility values: public, friends, friends_of_friends, private.

400.description: invalid body or invalid visibility value

post.description: Dry-run a default-visibility change, returning the volume IDs of entries that would become more exposed - backs the warning dialog before the caller commits to the change.

400.description: invalid body or invalid visibility value

post.description: Link a catalog volume into the caller's own library.

delete.description: Unlink a catalog volume from the caller's own library.

put.description: Refresh the denormalized title snapshot on a single library entry.

404.description: no entry for this volume_id in the library

put.description: Set (or clear, with an empty visibility) a per-entry visibility override. Valid visibility values: public, friends, friends_of_friends, private.

400.description: invalid body or invalid visibility value

get.description: List the volumes a user has lent out, both open and returned.

post.description: Lend a catalog volume to a platform-linked user or a free-form name. Exactly one of borrower_user_id or borrower_name is required; when borrower_user_id is given, borrower_name must also be supplied as that user's display name.

400.description: volume_id missing, or borrower fields don't satisfy the exactly-one-of rule

409.description: volume is already out on an open loan

get.description: List the volumes a platform-linked user has borrowed, both open and returned.

delete.description: Permanently remove a loan record. Lender-only.

403.description: loan exists but is owned by a different lender

404.description: no loan with this ID exists

post.description: Mark a lent-out loan as returned. Lender-only.

403.description: loan exists but is owned by a different lender

404.description: no loan with this ID exists

get.description: List a user's tables, filtered to what the caller may see.

post.description: Create a new table, defaulting to private visibility.

get.description: Get one table by ID, if the caller may see it.

404.description: no table with this ID exists, or the caller may not see it

403.description: table exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no table with this ID exists

403.description: table exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no table with this ID exists

put.description: Set a table's visibility. Owner-only. Valid visibility values: public, friends, friends_of_friends, private.

400.description: invalid body or invalid visibility value

403.description: table exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no table with this ID exists

post.description: Add a catalog volume to a table's shared pool. Owner-only.

403.description: table exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no table with this ID exists

delete.description: Remove a catalog volume from a table's shared pool. Owner-only.

403.description: table exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no table with this ID exists

get.description: List a user's wishlists, filtered to what the caller may see.

post.description: Create a new named wishlist, defaulting to private visibility.

get.description: Get one wishlist by ID, if the caller may see it.

404.description: no wishlist with this ID exists, or the caller may not see it

403.description: wishlist exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no wishlist with this ID exists

post.description: Add a catalog volume to a wishlist. Owner-only.

403.description: wishlist exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no wishlist with this ID exists

delete.description: Remove a catalog volume from a wishlist. Owner-only.

403.description: wishlist exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no wishlist with this ID exists

put.description: Set a wishlist's visibility. Owner-only. Valid visibility values: public, friends, friends_of_friends, private.

400.description: invalid body or invalid visibility value

403.description: wishlist exists but is owned by a different user

404.description: no wishlist with this ID exists
